description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate exemption to Urban Development Authority for a period effective from 18.12.2014 to 17.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory notice regarding the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act. It involves regulatory action by the Public Utilities Commission, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure matter.
